1: //go:build windows || darwin

12: type ChatInfo struct {
13: 	ID          string    `json:"id"`
14: 	Title       string    `json:"title"`
15: 	UserExcerpt string    `json:"userExcerpt"`
16: 	CreatedAt   time.Time `json:"createdAt" ts_type:"Date" ts_transform:"new Date(__VALUE__)"`
17: 	UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updatedAt" ts_type:"Date" ts_transform:"new Date(__VALUE__)"`
18: }
19: 
20: type ChatsResponse struct {
21: 	ChatInfos []ChatInfo `json:"chatInfos"`
22: }
23: 
24: type ChatResponse struct {
25: 	Chat store.Chat `json:"chat"`
26: }
27: 
28: type Model struct {
29: 	Model      string     `json:"model"`
30: 	Digest     string     `json:"digest,omitempty"`
31: 	ModifiedAt *time.Time `json:"modified_at,omitempty"`
32: }
33: 
34: type ModelsResponse struct {
35: 	Models []Model `json:"models"`
36: }
37: 
38: type InferenceCompute struct {
39: 	Library string `json:"library"`
40: 	Variant string `json:"variant"`
41: 	Compute string `json:"compute"`
42: 	Driver  string `json:"driver"`
43: 	Name    string `json:"name"`

52: type ModelCapabilitiesResponse struct {

54: }

56: // ChatEvent is for regular chat messages and assistant interactions
57: type ChatEvent struct {
58: 	EventName string `json:"eventName" ts_type:"\"chat\" | \"thinking\" | \"assistant_with_tools\" | \"tool_call\" | \"tool\" | \"tool_result\" | \"tool_approval\" | \"done\" | \"chat_created\""`
59: 
60: 	// Chat/Assistant message fields
61: 	Content           *string    `json:"content,omitempty"`
62: 	Thinking          *string    `json:"thinking,omitempty"`
63: 	ThinkingTimeStart *time.Time `json:"thinkingTimeStart,omitempty" ts_type:"Date | undefined" ts_transform:"__VALUE__ && new Date(__VALUE__)"`
64: 	ThinkingTimeEnd   *time.Time `json:"thinkingTimeEnd,omitempty" ts_type:"Date | undefined" ts_transform:"__VALUE__ && new Date(__VALUE__)"`
65: 
66: 	// Tool-related fields
67: 	ToolCalls      []store.ToolCall `json:"toolCalls,omitempty"`
68: 	ToolCall       *store.ToolCall  `json:"toolCall,omitempty"`
69: 	ToolName       *string          `json:"toolName,omitempty"`
70: 	ToolResult     *bool            `json:"toolResult,omitempty"`
71: 	ToolResultData any              `json:"toolResultData,omitempty" ts_type:"JSONValue"`
72: 
73: 	// Chat creation fields
74: 	ChatID *string `json:"chatId,omitempty"`
75: 
76: 	// Approval fields, sent with a "tool_approval" event when a tool may not
77: 	// run until the user answers. The answer is posted back to
78: 	// /api/v1/chat/{id}/approval carrying ApprovalID.
79: 	ApprovalID    *string        `json:"approvalId,omitempty"`
80: 	ApprovalScope *string        `json:"approvalScope,omitempty"`
81: 	ApprovalArgs  map[string]any `json:"approvalArgs,omitempty" ts_type:"{[key: string]: JSONValue}"`
82: 
83: 	// Tool state field from the new code
84: 	ToolState any `json:"toolState,omitempty" ts_type:"JSONValue"`
85: }
86: 
87: // DownloadEvent is for model download progress
88: type DownloadEvent struct {
89: 	EventName string `json:"eventName" ts_type:"\"download\""`
90: 	Total     int64  `json:"total" ts_type:"number"`
91: 	Completed int64  `json:"completed" ts_type:"number"`
92: 	Done      bool   `json:"done" ts_type:"boolean"`
93: }
94: 
95: // ErrorEvent is for error messages
96: type ErrorEvent struct {
97: 	EventName string `json:"eventName" ts_type:"\"error\""`
98: 	Error     string `json:"error"`
99: 	Code      string `json:"code,omitempty"`    // Optional error code for different error types
100: 	Details   string `json:"details,omitempty"` // Optional additional details
101: }
102:

111: type User struct {
112: 	ID        string `json:"id"`
113: 	Email     string `json:"email"`
114: 	Name      string `json:"name"`
115: 	Bio       string `json:"bio,omitempty"`
116: 	AvatarURL string `json:"avatarurl,omitempty"`
117: 	FirstName string `json:"firstname,omitempty"`

125: }

129: 	Prompt      string       `json:"prompt"`

139: 	Error string `json:"error"`
140: }

145: }

147: // Serializable data for the browser state
148: type BrowserStateData struct {
149: 	PageStack  []string         `json:"page_stack"`  // Sequential list of page URLs
150: 	ViewTokens int              `json:"view_tokens"` // Number of tokens to show in viewport
151: 	URLToPage  map[string]*Page `json:"url_to_page"` // URL to page contents
152: }
153: 
154: // Page represents the contents of a page
155: type Page struct {
156: 	URL       string         `json:"url"`
157: 	Title     string         `json:"title"`
158: 	Text      string         `json:"text"`
159: 	Lines     []string       `json:"lines"`
160: 	Links     map[int]string `json:"links,omitempty" ts_type:"Record<number, string>"`
161: 	FetchedAt time.Time      `json:"fetched_at"`
162: }
163: 
164: // MCPTool is one tool a connected MCP server is offering the model.
165: type MCPTool struct {
166: 	Name        string `json:"name"`
167: 	Description string `json:"description"`
168: }
169: 
170: // MCPSkippedTool is a tool Ollama refused to offer, and why. These are shown
171: // rather than swallowed: a user whose tool is missing needs to know it was
172: // rejected rather than absent.
173: type MCPSkippedTool struct {
174: 	Name   string `json:"name"`
175: 	Reason string `json:"reason"`
176: }
177: 
178: // MCPServer is one configured MCP server as the app presents it: what it would
179: // run, whether Ollama may run it, and what it is currently offering.
180: type MCPServer struct {
181: 	Name      string `json:"name"`
182: 	Status    string `json:"status"`
183: 	Transport string `json:"transport"`
184: 	// Runs is the command line or URL, shown verbatim. It is what the user
185: 	// reads before approving.
186: 	Runs    string `json:"runs"`
187: 	Enabled bool   `json:"enabled"`
188: 	// Approved reports whether this exact spec has been agreed to.
189: 	Approved bool `json:"approved"`
190: 	// Changed reports that the server was approved once but has been edited
191: 	// since, so what it would now run has never been agreed to.
192: 	Changed bool `json:"changed,omitempty"`
193: 	// PreviouslyRan is the command line that was approved, shown beside the
194: 	// current one so the change is visible rather than merely detected.
195: 	PreviouslyRan string           `json:"previouslyRan,omitempty"`
196: 	Error         string           `json:"error,omitempty"`
197: 	Tools         []MCPTool        `json:"tools,omitempty"`
198: 	Skipped       []MCPSkippedTool `json:"skipped,omitempty"`
